rationale: Best run (6.302) is limited at ss 100C 1.60V max-RC by a port path; its reg-to-reg is 6.126. Both are well under the repair aim (7.02-0.4=6.62), so repair is idle there, and target and margins are already at their limits. AREA 3 stays: its reg-to-reg is ~6.1-6.4 at any target, DELAY 3/4 only reached their aims (>=7.3) and AREA 2 stalled at 9.0. The remaining lever is physical: going from util 30 to 36 cut wirelength 57.3k->54.0k um and reg-to-reg 6.36->6.13, and a smaller die shortens pin nets. Hold (0 buffers), slew/cap (0 vs 309) and DRC (converges to 0) leave headroom. A: that run at util 42. B: util 46 with tighter slew/cap repair (40/35).
